hero.title: Built to Give Your Team Their Time Back.
hero.copy: We build custom internal tools, automation, and AI workflows for businesses in Kuala Lumpur and across Malaysia. Less busywork. More bandwidth for the work that actually matters.

features.title: Custom internal tools
features.copy: Built around how your team actually works. Not how a generic SaaS vendor assumes you do.

features.title: CRM and client management
features.copy: One place to track leads, clients, tasks, and follow-ups. No more chasing threads across three apps.

features.title: AI powered workflows
features.copy: Smart automation that handles drafting, routing, classifying, and summarising. With a human in the loop where it counts.

features.title: Process automation
features.copy: Approvals, reminders, handoffs, data entry. Automated properly so they stop eating time.

features.title: Dashboards and reporting
features.copy: The numbers your team actually needs, presented clearly, updated automatically.

features.title: Custom web apps

ctaTitle: Ready to Reclaim Your Team's Time?

extraFaqs.question: Do you build fully custom software?
extraFaqs.answer: Yes. We build internal tools, CRM systems, dashboards, portals, and web apps tailored to your specific workflow. Not off-the-shelf tools bent to fit.

extraFaqs.question: What kinds of things can you automate?
extraFaqs.answer: Almost anything repetitive: follow-ups, approvals, status updates, data routing, reminders, reporting. We start by mapping what your team actually does manually, then figure out what's worth automating.

extraFaqs.question: When does AI actually make sense in a business system?
extraFaqs.answer: When it saves real time or makes decisions better. Document parsing, smart routing, content drafting, classification, summarisation. These are areas where AI earns its keep. We won't bolt it on just to say it's there.
